notes: - **Code** widens `P`, `S`, and `L` with stroke compensation, extends the leg of `R`, opens the upper bowl of `B`, and insets the upper arm of `K`.

- Interior capitals anchor smart spacing in identifiers such as `HTTPServer` and `ParseResponse`. At identifier edges, `R` and `K` fit rounded lowercase, and `I` can tuck inward. These adjustments keep character advances fixed.
- Texture Healing adds intermediate and wide `M` and `W` in upright and italic Code. Upright also has lowercase `m` and `w` alternates. Enable `ss04` to turn Texture Healing off.
- **Sans and System** carry forward their 1.1.1 outlines and layout.
- All three families include upright and italic styles, print specimens, and a browser proof. [Interactive proof](https://daikonic-org.github.io/transit-typeface/).
